`final class EventBus`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [EventBus.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/EventBus.java)

Holds the listeners of an object, one ordered list per event type, and runs them when an event fires.

## Description

Every node and every UI holds its listeners in an `EventBus`; their `onX`, `beforeX` and `handleX` methods add to it.
The listeners of one type run in the order of their [`EventPriority`](/reference/events/eventpriority/), then in the order they were added.
A listener that throws does not stop the others: JOID prints a warning once for each new failure of that listener and runs the next one.

- [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/#order-the-listeners-of-one-event)

<a id="EventBus-factory-create"></a>

### create

`EventBus create(Supplier<String> owner)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates an empty bus.
`owner` gives the name of the object that holds it, printed in the warning of a listener that fails.

### addAll

`this addAll(EventBus bus)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

<a id="EventBus-method-keep"></a>

### keep

`this keep()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Marks every listener added so far as permanent: `reset()` keeps them.
A UI calls it when it opens for the first time, so that the listeners of its constructor survive every closing.

<a id="EventBus-method-reset"></a>

### reset

`this reset()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Removes every listener that `keep()` did not mark.
A UI calls it when it opens and when it closes, so that the listeners added in `init()` last one opening.

<a id="EventBus-method-clear"></a>

### clear

`this clear()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Removes every listener, the permanent ones included.

<a id="EventBus-method-fire"></a>

### fire

`void fire(EventType<?> type, Event event)` 

Runs the listeners of a type: first `fireListeners`, then `fireMonitor`.

<a id="EventBus-method-fireListeners"></a>

### fireListeners

`void fireListeners(EventType<?> type, Event event)` 

Runs the listeners of a type that are not `MONITOR`, in their order, and stops as soon as one of them cancels or consumes the event.

<a id="EventBus-method-fireMonitor"></a>

### fireMonitor

`void fireMonitor(EventType<?> type, Event event)` 

Runs the `MONITOR` listeners of a type, even when the event is cancelled or consumed.
The event is read-only for them: `cancel()` or `consume()` throws an `IllegalStateException`.

<a id="EventBus-method-has"></a>

### has

`boolean has(EventType<?> type)` 

If `true`, at least one listener listens to the type.
